question: The mode and median of a data set is 14.2 and 60, respectively. What is the mean of the data set? (Use empirical formula.)
solution:
**Given:**

Mode = 14.2

Median = 60

**Formula used:**

Empirical formula: Mean − Mode = 3 × (Mean − Median)

**Calculations:**

Mean − 14.2 = 3 × (Mean − 60)

⇒ Mean − 14.2 = 3Mean − 180

⇒ −14.2 + 180 = 3Mean − Mean

⇒ 165.8 = 2Mean

⇒ Mean = 82.9

**∴ The mean of the data set is 82.9**
